_comment: Shrink-only ratchets for the Podcast Factory Astro Site. Numbers here are a
RECORD of today's debt, not a target: each may fall and none may rise.
Enforced by scripts/check-frontend-ratchets.mjs (npm run ratchets), wired into CI.
After genuinely improving a number: npm run ratchets:update, which refuses to
lintWarnings is per RULE, not one total, so a new `any` cannot hide behind
someone else's fixed hook warning and still read as progress.
fileSize: every file is governed by exactly ONE rule. A file at or under the
ceiling is governed by the ceiling; a file above it is governed by its own
recorded pin, which it may fall below and may never exceed. So the grandfathered
list holds only genuine outliers and shrinks as they are split.
1000 chosen by Asif 2026-08-11 over the 800 the audit proposed. Context: across
324 non-test source files the median is 123 lines and p95 is 709, so either
number leaves the great majority clear; 1000 grandfathers 8 files where 800
would have grandfathered 12, and gives a legitimately large page more room
before it has to argue with the gate.
